EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Tonight we're going to see a lovely
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}autumn moon{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} It's a beautiful full

{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Luna de Otoño{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Solo brilla así

{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Cette nuit, la lune va briller de mille

Vollmond zu sehen bekommen.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Tonight in {{TAG:0005:0005:}},{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} we'll be able
to see an amazing {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}autumn moon{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}The full moon shines so brightly at

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Que no se te olvide que esta noche

{{TAG:0003:0001:}}La luna brilla como el oro en esta

IT:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Stasera {{TAG:0005:0005:}} sarà rischiarata

DE:

ich mir nicht entgehen. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Weißt du,

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Tonight we'll get to see something
special.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} The {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}autumn moon {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}is a full
moon right around harvest time.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}I can't wait for it to light up the
night sky later!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Esta noche seremos testigos de
la {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Luna de Otoño{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}. Es una luna llena
que se ve en la época de la cosecha.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡Estoy deseando ver como
se ilumina el cielo esta noche!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ce soir, un spectacle exceptionnel
nous attend :{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} la {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}lune d'automne{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}C'est la pleine lune de la saison des

ammirare la {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}luna d'autunno{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Non vedo l'ora che spunti e illumini
la notte! Sarà fantastique!

{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Bu gece özel bir şey göreceğiz.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Sonbahar
Ayı{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}, hasat zamanlarına denk

sabırsızlıkla bekliyorum!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Isn't the {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}autumn moon {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}beautiful?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} It
shines so brightly at this time of
year.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Right around harvest time!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}La luna d'autunno{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}} {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}è belliiissima,
n'est-ce pas?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} La cornice ideale
per una bella cenetta romantica!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ich mag den Herbst gerne.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Nicht
nur, weil es zur Erntezeit immer das
frischeste Obst und Gemüse gibt...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Sondern auch, weil der Mond heute,

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Isn't the moon beautiful tonight?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} I
find myself stopping to stare up at
it.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} We call this an {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}autumn moon{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Esta {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Luna de Otoño{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} transmite
una energía astral que es magnífica
para la regeneración de los chakras.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Tu as vu comme la lune est belle ce
soir ?{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} C'est la {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}lune d'automne{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}, je
pourrais la contempler des heures !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}La luna è un vero spettacolo oggi,
n'est-ce pas?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Non posso fare altro
che ammirarla.
Il suo colore giallo dorato mi
ricorda le spighe di grano maturo.
Adoooro la nostra luna d'autunno!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ist der Mond nicht schön heute
Nacht? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Ich kann gar nicht aufhören,
ihn anzustarren.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:002B:}} So hell, so golden!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ay bu gece çok güzel değil mi?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Kendimi
durup ona bakarken buluyorum.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Buna
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Sonbahar Ayı{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} diyoruz!

IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}La luna che risplende stasera
su {{TAG:0005:0005:}} è favolooosa.
Mi fa sentire diversa...
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Eh sì, la luna d'autunno fa venire
a tutti voglia di cambiare pelle
e di trasformarsi, n'est-ce pas?

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}The moon is gorgeous tonight,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} isn't
it?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} I wish I could put a few drops of
its light in a jar for later.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}But instead,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} I'll just gaze up at this
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}autumn moon{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} and think about the
fall harvest.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Qué luz tan bonita{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Cómo me
gustaría poder guardarla en
un botecito para verla siempre.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Pero como eso no se puede hacer,
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}prefiero concentrarme en gozar
de esta {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Luna de Otoño{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}La pleine lune est magnifique, tu ne
trouves pas ?{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Aucune photo ne

{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Non, il faut voir de ses propres yeux

{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Non ci sono parole per descrivere

n'est-ce pas?
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Aaah, se solo avessi una macchina

DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ist der Vollmond nicht einfach nur

nur in der {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Nacht des Herbstmondes{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ich wünschte, ich hätte eine Kamera,

richtig einfangen kann.
